selection_input: annotation attributes, category presence, page IDs and authoritative provenance only
language_document_balance: outer round-robin across sorted existing languages; inner round-robin across sorted data_source groups; seeded page rank inside each cell; report layout marginals
plain_control_meaning: ordinary-text control with no nonignored table/figure/display-formula/code block; may contain inline formulas; not a formula-negative label
empty_stratum: record deficit; never borrow quota or replace after inspecting outputs
unknown_family: one shared unresolved-provenance group; no claim of independent source families; no division into development and confirmatory subsets
verified_family: only explicit dataset provenance keys; never infer paper identity from page number, filename prefix or layout
duplicates: reject duplicate page IDs; known image byte duplicates checked before live evaluation
selection_freeze: manifest and metadata hashes fixed before candidate predictions; no output-driven reselection
